changes.title: Hard odds rule: every leg and every ticket priced -950 to +1,000,000
changes.detail: No leg at -1000 or shorter on any board (ladder, Kings Pick, Lottery, green, Live, props, TD, 3s & rebounds, strict and researched 2-leg, Value singles; MD links follow the same picks). Ticket combined odds must also be -950 to +1,000,000, which removed the 10,000x+ Lottery tiers. Enforced at selection in build.py/extra.py/extra2.py/twoleg.py and re-checked over every published board file before each publish (oddsrule.py). Past graded tickets keep the prices they were posted at.

changes.title: ROI ledger (1 unit flat per ticket at the posted FanDuel price) is now the main score
changes.detail: Overall, by board, bet type, sport, model version and day, plus the separate boards. Computed for the full history because every posted ticket stored its price.

changes.title: Value singles board: Pinnacle no-vig chance minus FanDuel break-even of 6+ pts
changes.detail: Threshold picked on the older half of graded legs priced -950 or longer (Oct 25-Nov 3) and scored on the newer half (Nov 4-14). Newer half at 6+ pts: 12-1 (92.3%), +1.47u, +11.3% ROI on 13 legs, vs the v1 top leg per game on the same dates: 85.6% hit, -1.99% ROI. Very small sample: confidence labels stay conservative.

changes.title: Tickets capped at 6 legs (ladder and Lottery)
changes.detail: Posted ladder/Lottery/Kings Pick tickets, older half: all sizes 16.3% hit, -233.1u; capped at 6 legs 35.5%, -63.0u. Newer half: 23.5%, -13.9u -> 41.2%, +86.0u (one ~100x hit; without the single biggest win both halves still improve: -249.4 -> -67.3u and -116.6 -> -16.7u). The cap lowers top payouts.

changes.title: Player props and NBA 3s & rebounds tickets capped at 6 legs
changes.detail: Props: older half 32.7% -> 63.3% hit, -64.0 -> -7.9u; newer half 38.4% -> 58.5%, -34.6 -> -12.4u. 3s & rebounds: older 23.5% -> 43.3%, -67.3 -> -25.3u; newer 35.7% -> 63.6%, -50.6 -> -5.1u. TD tickets were already 6 legs or fewer. Live combos are not capped (their logged prices can't be trusted for a backtest).

changes.title: Top leg per game ranked by isotonic calibration (sport x market), refit on all graded legs every refresh
changes.detail: 50/50 time split, legs priced -950 or longer: top-leg hit 85.6% -> 86.4%, units -9.08 -> -3.01 (457 games). 70/30 split: 86.1% -> 87.5%, -2.88 -> +1.21 (216). Displayed chances stay v1 because the isotonic probabilities had slightly worse Brier/log loss.

changes.title: Platt scaling by sport
changes.detail: No change in which legs are picked, and slightly worse log loss out of sample.

changes.title: Skip legs whose FanDuel price moved 2+ pts against
changes.detail: Hit rate unchanged on the 50/50 split (+0.07u only); v1 already applies a -1 pt line-move adjustment. Not a clear improvement in both hit rate and units.

changes.title: Rank legs by chance + 0.5 x v1 edge; rank by calibrated EV
changes.detail: Both lowered hit rate out of sample, and EV ranking also lost more units.

changes.title: Value 2-leg parlays (pairs of Value singles)
changes.detail: Newer half: 16-7, -0.67u (-2.9% ROI) on 23 pairs. Value is shown as singles only.

changes.title: v1 stays live
changes.detail: Same games, top leg per game as 1-unit singles: v1 84.7% hit, -4.6% ROI vs v2 (Pinnacle-anchored) 87.1%, -2.2% (before the odds rule). v2's ladders lost more in earlier rebuild tests; Pinnacle prices are used directly in the Value board instead.
